test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

She couldn't really be __irritated__ with him.
solution:
The correct answer is option no.(4) i.e.** 'Annoyed'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** irritated **means to provoke impatience,anger,or displeasure or to cause irritability**.(परेशान करना , तंग करना)**

 
 
• **Example:- **Harsh soap irritated the skin.
 
 
 
• The word **annoyed **means to disturb or to harass especially by quick brief attacks.**(चिढ़ाना/परेसान करना)**
 
 
• **Example:-** They annoyed the neighbors with their loud arguments.
 
 
 
• Both the words **Irritated and Annoyed **are similar in meanings.

Therefore, the the correct answer is option no.**(4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options are:**

 
 
• **Obliged-** To put in one's debt by a favor or service.**(एहशान करना, आभारी होना)**
 
• **Delighted- **A high of gratification or pleasure.**(प्रसन्न/ख़ुशी)**
 
• **Pleased- **To afford or give pleasure or satisfaction.**(प्रफुल्ल)**
 
 

192:Ta60,
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.<
